name: MetaModule Final Coverage Audit Contract
purpose: separate structural completeness from Event completeness while auditing all known MetaModule families toward final AIGMos coverage

required: members or consumed semantics where applicable
ports where externally/locally bindable behavior exists

events.rule: do not synthesize Events merely to satisfy completeness

finalStatusRule: FINAL_CANDIDATE requires STRUCTURE_PROVEN and an explicit Event review result; missing Event evidence is handled as its own review item rather than blocking structural modeling
evidenceRules: historical material may establish candidates/provenance but must not silently override newer canonical decisions
counts do not prove unique semantic identities
examples are not promoted to canonical identities without evidence
